comment: Three mechanisms. 'priority_draws': chance to force a specific room (or one of a named set) into slot 3 whenever it is draftable. 'forced_draws': a DIFFERENT mechanic (wiki.gg/Drafting/Advanced) -- once per day, the first time a doorway is opened where a listed room's own draft conditions + a gate are met, roll a very-high chance to push that specific room into slot 3; on success it is unavailable for the rest of the day even if the placement itself then fails (e.g. the room already occupies an earlier slot of the same hand). 'category_biases': conditional biases that force a category re-deal with the given chance while their condition holds (King's Chess Piece variants, constellations, room auras). Chances are fractions.

blueprince.wiki.gg/wiki/Garage datamined box: 'the chance of the roll succeeding is 90%. If the West Gate permanent addition has been unlocked, the chance is increased to 92.5%.' Gate: 'Veteran Mode is active, or Day 3 has been reached.'
meta.notes: Only the Garage slice of forced_draw_precedence is implemented (owner decision); conservatory/morning_room/utility_closet remain unbuilt pending their own prerequisites (Found Floorplan, Bacon & Eggs, and Garage-drafted-first respectively). The separate Day-5-or-Veteran 3% passive Priority Draw for the Garage (wiki) is a different, unimplemented mechanic -- do not conflate the two gates.

meta.source: sheet constants: 'Electro Magnet 40% Mechanical Rooms, plus Rotunda'; wiki.gg/Drafting/Advanced
meta.notes: Live: category 'mechanical_or_rotunda' is a union resolved by draft.py's CATEGORY_UNIONS/_category_matches -- the 8 Mechanical Rooms (category 'mechanical') plus the Rotunda by id, since the Rotunda itself carries category 'blueprint'. condition 'electromagnet' is emitted by _active_conditions while a Powered Electromagnet is held (special_items.json effect tag 'electromagnet', checked via electromagnet_active_from_state).

colour_defaults.comment: Per-colour default floorplans for a colour-selective draft (wiki.gg/Drafting_effects, 'List of default floorplans for each selectable color type'), tried in order once the ordinary pool draw comes up empty. 'swap' replaces one default with another while any of 'swap_when_upgraded' is applied: the Cloister leaves green when upgraded, and the Solarium takes its place.
